name: Single-Leg Extension
steps: Sit firmly against the backrest with your knees aligned to the machine pivot, grip the side handles, and hook one ankle behind the shin pad.
Brace your hips into the seat and extend your working knee smoothly until your leg is fully straight.
Pause briefly at the top to contract your quadriceps hard while keeping the opposite leg relaxed.
Lower the pad slowly back to the start without letting the stack slam, then switch legs after completing one side.
tips: Keep your hips and lower back pressed steadily into the pad instead of lifting off the seat.
Move smoothly through a full range without kicking the pad upward with momentum.
